title: 第9章 修士的自我修养第10章 周黎
lines: 看着摇摇欲坠的无念，我叹息一声。
“我帮不了你，也不了解你经历了什么，这地方你想呆多久呆多久，一切都看你自己了。”
听到我的话，无念有些感激的冲我点了点头，然后一屁股坐下，手里还牢牢拿着那被咬了一口的黄瓜。
看到这里我一阵无语，叹了口气，摇了摇头，我走进了小楼，关上了门。
不是我冷血，而是我不了解眼前这人，甚至我都不了解这个地方！
怎么能轻易去打破它的宁静？
况且我用那黄瓜换了很多东西，我都没有来得及看呢！
外面地方挺大的，现在天气又不冷，况且是那家伙自己给自己一掌的，生死跟我没有一点关系，我甚至还为他说好话，把那些人都赶走了，甚至在说话前，我都不确定下面的那些人到底听不听我的。
算了，不管了，我现在还泥菩萨过江呢，各凭造化，听天由命吧！
扛着那黄色的布袋我来到了小院。
不知道为何，我现在扛着布袋没有任何吃力，力气大的好像用不完一般。
来到小院的空地上，我照着无念教我的办法，把布袋打开了。
哗啦一声，里面的东西散落一地，都快把小院填满了。
看着这么多东西，我摇了摇头，这布袋装的是挺多的，但是这也太乱了吧。
看都费劲，找到那个红葫芦和我看中的那几个石头，我开始分类了起来。
一种种一件件，什么东西都有，我甚至都在里面发现了内裤似的东西。
这看的我满头黑线，不过那内裤摸起来布料挺不错的，算了先扔一边吧，继续分类，里面都是些什么药丸，草药之类的，我也不认识，也不敢乱吃，大致的看了看，却看到了许多书籍。
这让顿时来了兴趣，说不定这里面记载了我想知道的东西。
书籍很杂乱，颜色也各异，有的看起来如同天书一般，有的却是些鬼画符，皱着眉头，终于有两本书让我看懂了些。
《修士的自我修养》和《古籍》
翻开《修士的自我修养》，上面的字体跟我认识的大差不差。
“修行本就是逆天而行，我辈修士粉身碎骨在所不惜，胆小者勿看。”
翻开第一页一行字就映入眼帘。
“修行？”
我眉头紧皱，其实来到这里以后，我也隐隐明白了些什么，但是当这本书摆在我的眼前的时候，还是有那么一丝的震惊。
“我辈修士自开天辟地以来，经历数以万年，终形成一套完整的修行等级！”
下一页介绍的却是修行者的等级。
其实让我不知道的是，这种书在中州一抓一大把，甚至在凡人国度之间都有很多，这本书根本不是什么秘密，甚至修士上茅房都不用它，嫌它剌屁股。
当然，我并不知道这些，无念收那些弟子的东西，其实都是些这种无用的东西，但是对我来说，却是另一种状态。
如果看书就能修行，那普天之下怕全部都是修士了。
继续翻下去，下面介绍的却是些等级，和修行的入门。
我大概看了一遍，也了解了许多，明白了这地方是中州，除了广袤的中州，中州之外还有什么娑罗州，天南州，北俱州，弥沙州什么的。
反正说这个地方非常非常之大！
大的超出了我的认知！
修行也划分为，淬体，筑基，入微，金丹，观心，灵台。
往上还有什么神游，更往上还有入圣之境。
看得我一阵头大。
只是书上说的神游之境中州一个都没有。
下面介绍的却是如何淬体，光是看淬体都看的我一阵头大。
content_en:
Looking at the crumbling Wu Nian, I sighed.
"I can't help you, and I don't know what you've been through. How long you want to stay here is up to you."
After hearing my words, Wu Nian nodded to me gratefully, then sat down, still holding the bitten cucumber firmly in his hand.
Seeing this, I was speechless for a while, sighed, shook my head, walked into the small building and closed the door.
It’s not that I’m cold-blooded, it’s that I don’t understand the person in front of me, or even this place!
How can you easily break its tranquility?
Besides, I exchanged that cucumber for a lot of things, and I didn’t even have time to see them!
The place outside is quite big, and the weather is not cold now. Besides, the guy gave me the slap. Life or death has nothing to do with me. I even said good things to him and drove those people away. Even before I spoke, I was not sure whether the people below would listen to me.
Forget it, never mind, I'm still crossing the river like a clay Buddha, let's just leave it to fate!
Carrying the yellow cloth bag, I came to the small courtyard.
I don’t know why, but I don’t have any difficulty carrying the bag now. I seem to have endless strength.
When I came to the open space in the small courtyard, I opened the bag according to the method Wu Nian taught me.
With a crash, the contents were scattered all over the floor, almost filling the small courtyard.
Looking at so many things, I shook my head. There was quite a lot in this bag, but it was too messy.
It took a lot of effort to find the red gourd and the few stones I was interested in, and I started to sort them.
There was one thing after another, everything was there, I even found something that looked like underwear inside.
I saw black lines all over my head, but the fabric of the underwear felt quite good, so I just threw it aside and continued to sort. I didn’t know what kind of pills, herbal medicines, etc. were inside, and I didn’t dare to eat them randomly. I took a rough look and saw many books.
This immediately made me interested, maybe it contains something I want to know.
The books were very messy and had different colors. Some looked like heavenly books, while others had ghostly drawings on them. I frowned. Finally, there were two books that I could understand better.
"The Self-cultivation of Monks" and "Ancient Books"
When I opened "The Self-cultivation of a Monk", the fonts on it were very different from what I recognized.
"Cultivation is all about going against nature. We monks will not hesitate to break our bodies to pieces. Don't watch this for the faint of heart."
As soon as you turn the first page, a line of text comes into view.
"Practice?"
I frowned. In fact, after I came here, I vaguely understood something, but when this book was placed in front of me, I was still a little shocked.
"Since the beginning of the world, our monks have gone through tens of thousands of years and finally formed a complete set of cultivation levels!"
The next page introduces the levels of practitioners.
In fact, what I don’t know is that there are a lot of this kind of books in Zhongzhou, and there are even many in the mortal realm. This book is not a secret at all. Even the monks don’t use it when they go to the latrine, because they think it irritates their buttocks.
Of course, I didn't know this. The things Wu Nian collected from those disciples were actually useless things, but for me, it was a different state.
If you can practice cultivation by reading books, then all the people in the world will be monks.
Keep scrolling, what follows is an introduction to some levels and the introduction to practice.
I read it about once and learned a lot about it. I understood that this place is Zhongzhou. In addition to the vast Zhongzhou, there are other states such as Sara, Tiannan, Beiju, and Misha.
Anyway, this place is very, very big!
Bigger than I knew!
Cultivation is also divided into body tempering, foundation building, subtlety, golden elixir, mind contemplation, and spiritual platform.
There is still some kind of wandering in the world above, and even higher still there is the realm of sainthood.
It made me feel dizzy.
It’s just that there isn’t any Zhongzhou in the realm of divine wandering mentioned in the book.
What is introduced below is how to temper the body. Just looking at the body tempering makes me feel dizzy.
title_en: Chapter 9 The Self-cultivation of Monks Chapter 10 Zhou Li
